desc: Build adjacency list from edges with edge lengths and use iterative DFS for n up to 5e4.
During DFS maintain depth-indexed prefix length sums, last[value] = last occurrence depth on current path, and running max previous-occurrence depth m.
At node u at depth d, compute prev = last[nums[u]] or -1, m = max(parentMax, prev), start = m + 1; candidate length = pref[d] - pref[start], nodes = d - start + 1.
Update best answer using length first and fewer nodes on ties; handle single-node paths (best initialized to (0,1)).
Backtrack by restoring previous last[nums[u]] via an explicit exit frame.
Validate against provided examples ([6,2] and [0,1]) — both match.
